question:
Study the given bar-graph and answer the question that follows:

The bar-graph shows the number of students from a college who got placed in six companies in 2020. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0fbd9546017b520c29ab6418db32c89b03c58125c08c3187608cdb81589c376.png] 

If 60 students from the college did not get a job in any of these six companies, then what percentage of the students from this college were placed in H in 2020?
solution:
Calculation:

Total students = 26 + 50 + 36 + 16 + 24 + 28 + 60 = 240

Now, the required% = frac {36}{240} times 100\% = 15%

**∴ 15% of the students from this college were placed in H in 2020.**
